kept_items.author: OpenAI
kept_items.text: We will continue to offer Zero Data Retention for frontier models. As AI takes on longer, more autonomous work and delivers greater value to businesses, safety systems also need to identify risks across related interactions. To help address those risks, we're previewing Private Safety Processing, which is designed to improve safety without giving OpenAI personnel access to the underlying content.
kept_items.selection_reason: Special account. Self-contained top-level post announcing Private Safety Processing plus continued Zero Data Retention for frontier models.

kept_items.selection_reason: Special account. Self-contained top-level post; sama endorsing OpenAI's business-privacy / Private Safety Processing announcement made the same hour.

kept_items.author: OpenAIDevs
kept_items.text: Teams are using the open-source Codex harness to bring agents into the tools they already use, from internal apps to operations dashboards. Their applications control the interface, context, tools, and approvals while the harness handles the agent loop.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete product/adoption news on the open-source Codex harness embedding agents in internal apps.

kept_items.author: CerfiaFR
kept_items.text: FLASH | In the next 6 months, we will approach a world where a new version of ChatGPT will be able to watch your screen, record every meeting and call, and have a perfect context of your entire life to be incredibly helpful, asserts Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI.
kept_items.selection_reason: Notable Altman statement on near-term always-on ChatGPT context, high engagement.

kept_items.author: TareqAmin_
kept_items.text: A small sneak peek of something we've been working on for the past 12 months. Together with Qualcomm, we've been designing the next generation of the HUMAIN AI PC - bringing CPU, GPU and NPU together to run AI models locally, on the device.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete hardware announcement, HUMAIN/Qualcomm on-device AI PC, very high views.

kept_items.author: scottstts
kept_items.text: I predict that in 5-10 years every household will have a local AI server that serves all the AI workload of the house, digital or robotics. It'll be as common as a WiFi router or a fridge. It creates a private mesh network to link all the devices in the house and does inference
kept_items.selection_reason: Widely discussed practitioner prediction on local AI, very high engagement.

kept_items.author: ataiiam
kept_items.text: Introducing Open Bot. An open source Grok Bot that works with ANY agent harness, designed for real companies. It includes: AI Coworkers, Generative UI, Computer use (remote/local), Agent-human handoffs, Full data recording, owned by you.

kept_items.text: Joe Rogan uploads 2 to 3 hour episodes. You see 30 second clips. Someone cut them. Creators pay $29 a month for AI to do that job. A solo developer in China gave it away for free. The repo is called AutoClip. 6,391 stars on GitHub. 1,253 forks. MIT licensed.
